name: Odoo 20 Development
description: PRIMARY skill for this project. Odoo 20 knowledge base: Unified Security & ACL (ir.access, security/ir.access.csv, no ir.rule), OWL 3 (useProps, proxy, signals, plugins, explicit this. in templates), Models & ORM (CachedModel, compute_sql, init_storage, Domain AST), API Decorators (@api.ormcache from odoo.api, @api.readonly, @api.private), SQL Constraints (models.Constraint, models.Index, models.UniqueIndex), Views (<list> not <tree>, direct-expression attrs), Migration (v19→v20), Performance (search_fetch, _read_group). Use for ANY Odoo 20 Python/JS/XML/CSV code.

name: Odoo 19 Development
description: Odoo 19 knowledge base: Actions, Controllers, Data files, API Decorators, SQL Constraints (models.Constraint), Database Indexes, Field types, Mixins, ORM methods, Migration scripts, OWL components, Performance, QWeb Reports, Security/ACL, Testing, Translations, XML Views. Use only when working on Odoo 19 code.

name: Odoo Workflow (Pre-Code Gate)
description: MANDATORY pre-code gate for ANY Odoo change. Traces real source (file:line) before any design or coding. Covers: add field, override method, inherit view/xpath, OWL/JS patch, wizard, cron, controller, report, security, migration, bug fix, refactor. Also use when debugging tracebacks or install/upgrade errors (ParseError, missing xmlid). Run BEFORE planning or coding.

name: Odoo Test Runner
description: Run Odoo unit tests (TransactionCase/HttpCase) and XML-RPC end-to-end scenarios against a throwaway test database. Commands: odoo_test.sh unit <module>, odoo_test.sh serve, odoo_test.sh rpc, odoo_test.sh all. Use whenever code must be verified or logs inspected.

name: Odoo Commit Style
description: Guides Odoo-style git commits: [TAG] module: short description format, amend vs new commit logic, explicit file staging, git commit -F for multi-line messages. Auto-invokes for commit-related requests. Takes priority over generic commit skills.

name: DTG Base Utilities
description: Reference for the DTG Base abstract model (dtg_base.DTGBase). Provides utility methods for: date/time handling, barcode generation, timezone conversion, file operations, and more. Use when inheriting or calling DTGBase helpers in custom modules under addons_customs/erp/.

name: Security Review Checklist
description: Comprehensive security checklist and patterns. Activate when: implementing auth/authorization, handling user input or file uploads, creating API endpoints, working with secrets or credentials, implementing payments, storing/transmitting sensitive data, or integrating third-party APIs.

name: TDD Workflow
description: Enforces Test-Driven Development with 80%+ coverage (unit, integration, E2E). Activate when: writing new features, fixing bugs, refactoring, adding API endpoints, or creating new components. Red → Green → Refactor cycle.

name: Odoo Module index.html
description: Guide for creating a professional static/description/index.html for any Odoo module. Covers standard section layout (hero banner, demo screenshots, feature cards, comparison table, how-it-works steps, tech specs, support footer), asset organization (banner.png, icon.png, assets/), manifest image declaration, and writing conventions (English only, inline CSS, Bootstrap 4, Font Awesome). Includes a reference implementation (index.html + assets) copied from a real module. Use whenever a module needs a new or improved App Store / module info page.
